about: Our people are everything. We come from all walks of life but share the common purpose of creating a sustainable planet.

The Drawdown Fund was inspired by the solutions outlined in Paul Hawken's New York Times Best Seller, " Drawdown: The Most Comprehensive Plan Ever Proposed to Reverse Global Warming. " The Fund was founded in 2018 by Paul Hawken and Erik Snyder to scale existing market-based solutions to reverse global warming. Paul and Erik were compelled to build the Drawdown Fund given their shared vision of a better world for our children and their belief in humanity’s ability to solve our greatest challenges.

Today, total greenhouse gases in the atmosphere have surpassed 490 parts per million and continue to rise. Greenhouse gases in the atmosphere have never been higher than 300 parts per million in the last 400,000 years. At that time, sea levels were 16ft higher and 75% of the earth that we populate was underwater. ​

With human population expected to grow another 50% by 2050 and GDP per capita to increase 25% by 2025, macro trends will further strain our planet’s resources and are likely to accelerate the pace of human-induced climate change.

Despite whatever negative news may exist, Paul, Erik, and the Drawdown team remain optimistic. Recognizing the urgency, we believe that the greatest challenges facing humanity are also our greatest opportunities. We are seeing more and more growth stage companies rising to the challenges posed by climate change. With the right community of investors, aligned stakeholders, and fearless entrepreneurs, we are confident that we can demonstrate the most attractive business case for climate impact yet. We hope you will join us.
At the Drawdown Fund, we are creating a different kind of investment firm rooted in our core values:

We are a learning organization, innately curious, and believe we have something to learn from everyone. We believe that wonder is just as much about asking the right questions as it is about finding answers.
Short-term thinking has led us to where we are and only long-term thinking can get us out. We’re in it for the long game and are not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo.
home: Investing in world-class growth stage businesses at the forefront of the sustainable revolution.

Drawdown is the turning point at which we are reducing carbon at a rate greater than we are emitting it. Our businesses are expected to have a meaningful impact on this equation.

home: Droia invests globally in young drug development companies that use novel science and innovative approaches to bring promising therapies to patients. We are specialists, investing exclusively in therapeutics for oncology and genetic disease.

Our focus and our in-house team of drug development experts and biotech professionals allow us to accelerate our companies’ progress by actively supporting them from company creation through clinical proof of concept. We are hands-on investors and entrepreneurs, fully dedicated to making an impact and saving patient lives.

For biotech companies, ultimate success is measured in effective patient benefit. Promising therapies should have a material impact on patient prognosis, measured as a function of the severity of the unmet medical need addressed and the improvement in therapeutic benefits as compared to (expected) standard of care.

We only invest in companies that are able, through their technology platforms or scientific insights, to go after previously unsolvable clinical problems. Companies should differentiate not only by way of innovation, but also in the way this innovation translates to clinical breakthrough.

Droia actively scouts for the best science and the best teams. Whether investing in an existing company or creating a new company, we actively participate in our portfolio companies’ development . Our team has deep and specialized experience in disease biology, translational science, clinical development and company building.

We have built many companies from the ground up, supporting and complementing founders and management teams. Our team members dedicate their time to helping their companies, and will take on interim roles within companies to help them get off the ground faster. Our whole organization is geared towards doing what we do best: building great drug development companies.

home: Partnering with non‑linear thinkers to unlock alpha

In Spanish speaking contexts, communication relies on tone, context, and relational cues.
Founders raised in this environment learn to process ambiguity, connect disparate ideas, and navigate complexity intuitively.
This cultural wiring becomes a competitive advantage: driving innovation, agility, and pattern recognition.

home: The Intelligence of Tomorrow's Infrastructure.
We are witnessing the most fundamental restructuring of European industry since 1990.

Geopolitical pressure, technological disruption and shifting security realities are forcing strategic realignment across every major sector. Automotive, logistics, energy, defence — none are untouched. We work precisely at this inflection point: where transformation is not a choice, but a condition.

The domains we work in are not sectors in the traditional sense. They are converging fields — reshaped by geopolitical pressure, technological disruption and shifting capital. We operate precisely where these forces intersect, because that is where the most consequential decisions are being made.
Satellite systems, ground infrastructure and institutional ecosystems — from New Space to sovereign PNT and SATCOM networks.
Software-defined Defence, dual-use technologies and digital resilience. We navigate the Zeitenwende and its industrial implications — from Cyber to ISR to NATO procurement logic.
Classic industries entering the space and defence economy. We map the path from traditional manufacturer to sovereign system integrator.
Defence-driven infrastructure as an asset class. Military mobility hubs, secure digital backbones, resilient energy networks — bankable, sovereign-backed, ESG-compatible.

Our advisory work is organised around four service lines — developed not from a methodology catalogue, but from the realities of the markets we operate in. Each one reflects where we have seen the greatest strategic need, and where we are able to create the most precise impact.

We advise on national and European transformation agendas — where regulatory shifts, geopolitical realignment and new technology imperatives force organisations to reposition. Our work bridges public institutions and industry at the moments that matter most.

about: Yvonne Bajela is the Founder and General Partner of Evertrue Capital. She has spent more than a decade backing category-defining companies From South London to Global Unicorn Investor | Yvonne Bajela, LocalGlobe The Startup Leap Watch on YouTube before consensus forms, including Wise, Marshmallow, Moove and Flutterwave.

Her career has spanned investing, operating and company-building across Europe, Africa and Asia. Across those experiences, a consistent pattern emerged: exceptional founders are often most interesting before the evidence is obvious, when their insight comes from unusually close proximity to a problem, and their ambition exceeds what the market can yet see.

Born in London with Ghanaian roots, Yvonne’s career has taken her from Japan to Kenya, Israel, South Africa and beyond. She has spent years building networks across markets, spotting ambitious talent beyond the usual circles, and helping founders scale across borders.

If founders need her, she shows up. 0:06 1 × “ Hey Yvonne, I know it’s super late, but do you mind going through the fundraising materials I’ve put together? ” A founder, in stealth If they don’t, she’s probably somewhere between a founder call, a long-haul flight and the next idea worth believing in early.

home: Evertrue is a pre-seed fund backing founders before consensus forms. I back founders who found a way through where others saw a wall. Farhan Thawar @ fnthawar It seems a common experience in the lives of people with high agency is that they, at some point, metaphorically, lean against a wall and discover that there is a hidden door. That some constraint they’ve been told about turns out not to hold, and this allows them to experience… 8 Aug 2026 Read it on X
Evertrue invests in the gap between what a founder has already proven and what they are capable of becoming.

I back founders with something to prove. People who have climbed a steep slope to get where they are, see what others have missed, and have the conviction to build around it. They treat building as their life's work, combine ambition with disciplined execution and can persuade exceptional people to join them. Often, they’re solving hard problems in what may appear to be unsexy markets.

I've been a founder and early-stage investor, backing companies at the very beginning that went on to define their categories. Evertrue brings that experience, network and judgement to the earliest stages of company building.

Conviction should have consequences How Evertrue Sees the World yvonnebajela.substack.com Read it ; I invest £250k–£500k at pre-seed, predominantly in founders with European roots. I’m building a concentrated portfolio and move quickly when I'm convinced. My approach is to show up when it matters, drawing on an inner circle of 50+ operators and former founders from Anthropic, Revolut, J.P. Morgan, and beyond to provide the right support.
Recognise early. Back with conviction. Stay for the build.

Aerodome is an innovative startup that provides an end-to-end automated drone response system for police and fire departments. After an agency receives an emergency call, a drone arrives on the scene within 3 minutes and steams video in real-time to responding personnel. This allows authorities to better assess the situation and respond accordingly, be it deploying officers, the fire department, or other emergency services.

Agree is a new payments platform built on top of e-signature. Imagine if docusign and bill.com were a fully-integrated experience while providing AI summaries in plain language for document sections, enabling users to understand content easily, ask specific questions about the document and assist the accounts receivable department.

Andercore provides custom software development services, specializing in building scalable, high-performance digital solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of businesses across various industries.

about: Founded by a team of early researchers and pioneers in the future of warfare and defence, Expeditions invests in leading startups at the intersection of security and deep tech. We champion innovation in these crucial sectors, aiming to break down institutional resistance and driving the policy changes that will enable exceptional European founders to succeed.
Our founders are experienced defence industry innovators, who have been contributing to policy and research on the use of AI in warfare since 2017.
Europe faces mounting threats. War on its borders, energy dependency, widening technology gaps, cyberattacks, disinformation, and drone warfare. These challenges demand action and a sense of urgency.

We believe that closer civil-military collaboration is Europe’s chance to spark a new industrial renaissance, fusing its defence needs with its world-class talent and entrepreneurial energy, and powering progress for years to come.

This moment demands builders who turn urgency into invention, and security challenges into global leadership. We exist to back those entrepreneurs designing the architecture of Europe’s security, and in doing so, restoring its economic and strategic power.

Dr Mikolaj Firlej is an investor, academic and policy expert in security and defence, specialising in the application of autonomous systems and AI. He completed his D.Phil at Oxford University with a thesis on ‘The Problematisation of Autonomous Weapon Systems’, and has been a deep tech investor since 2016. Miko co-founded Firlej Kastory, a private investment firm, and launched Expeditions, the leading early-stage investor in the future of European security, in 2021.

Miko has advised both the UK and Polish governments, working as a security analyst and policy advisor, and was also part of a UN Group of Governmental Experts on the regulation of autonomous weapons. He established the Centre for Technology and Global Affairs at Oxford University and has taught at the University of Surrey on AI Law and Regulation. He holds three Masters degrees in addition to his doctorate.

home: Partnering with the most ambitious founders building the future energy system

We believe the future of energy will be defined by electrification and orchestration. As economies replace fuel-based systems with renewable electricity, energy becomes increasingly interconnected across power, transport, buildings, industry, and digital infrastructure.

This transition creates a more dynamic and complex energy system. Electric vehicles become flexible grid assets; buildings become both consumers and producers of energy; industrial processes become increasingly electrified and digitally controlled. As renewable generation scales, the ability to forecast, optimise, store, transport, and coordinate energy becomes as important as producing it. Technologies such as AI, advanced software, and digital infrastructure play a critical role in enabling this coordination.

Creating this new energy future requires bold thinking and new business models. Future Energy Ventures exists to accelerate that transition by investing in the platforms, intelligence, and technologies that enable electrified energy systems to operate efficiently at scale. We partner with founders building solutions that help manage complexity, improve resilience, and unlock new sources of value across the energy ecosystem.

Future Energy Ventures is rooted in the energy industry, but we recognise that the future energy system extends far beyond traditional sector boundaries. Its success depends on collaboration between energy, mobility, industry, buildings, and digital technology. That is why we invest in companies that sit at these intersections, helping create an energy system that is more productive, resilient, and sustainable.
We back companies accelerating the shift to an electrified, software-defined energy system.

We invest in asset-light, scalable businesses—often at the intersection of energy and digital infrastructure—that unlock efficiency, flexibility, and new market structures. Our sweet spot is Series A+ companies with proven product–market fit, clear customer demand, and a model that can scale rapidly across geographies.
We look for founders who understand the complexity of energy markets and have the conviction to transform them

We provide our portfolio companies with funding, mentoring and connections to accelerate their growth trajectory via our network of highly committed partners and our integrated collaboration platform.

about: Investing in Adaptation for a Volatile World

First Imagine! is a European venture capital firm investing in scalable technologies that increase resilience, autonomy and productivity. Operating from Cyprus, London and Paris, we focus on founders building deep technological advantages in markets shaped by structural volatility and long-term system transformation.
To back exceptional entrepreneurs building the infrastructure of resilience.
Ten years of investing through a thesis that kept widening — because the problems did.
First Imagine! was established in London in 2016 by a team combining engineering, project development and investment experience, with deep roots in energy markets and industry.

That combination shaped our approach from the outset. We looked at technology not only through an investor’s lens, but also against the practical realities of building companies, developing projects and bringing new technologies into use in the real world.

Our original thesis was straightforward: Industry 4.0, cleantech and the energy transition were beginning to reshape how the world generates, moves and consumes energy. Many of the companies driving that transformation would be built in Europe.

Following Brexit, we established our EU office in Cyprus in 2020. Together, our London and Cyprus offices allow us to cover Europe from northwest to southeast, while staying close to the innovation ecosystems of the Eastern Mediterranean.
home: Building the Infrastructure of Resilience

First Imagine! is a European investment platform backing AdapTech: technologies that strengthen resilience, autonomy and productivity in an increasingly fragmented and volatile world. We back scalable innovations across energy, water & food, circularity, industry and digital infrastructure (cross-cutting AI).

Founded in 2016, First Imagine! backs entrepreneurs building the foundational systems of resilience. Our investment thesis is built around adaptation, industrial transformation and the latest technological developments that enable societies and businesses to thrive in a rapidly changing and unpredictable world.

The world is moving from transition to adaptation. Geopolitical fragmentation, supply-chain disruptions, climate stress and cyber risks are creating demand for a new generation of technologies focused on resilience rather than efficiency alone.
Distributed energy systems, microgrids, storage, energy orchestration and resilience infrastructure.
Desalination, precision agriculture, smart irrigation, food security and resource efficiency.
Resource recovery, advanced recycling, local materials production and zero-waste processes.
Robotics, automation, advanced manufacturing, industrial AI and agile production systems.
We invest in technologies emerging from the latest AI-enabled technological shifts, accelerating the evolution of resilience infrastructure, industrial systems and resource management.
Imagination is more important than knowledge.

about: Endurance is an independent financing platform focused on companies and projects operating across infrastructure, energy transition, industrials and sustainability. We provide a range of tailored financing solutions — across debt and structured capital — to businesses with proven technology, visible commercial demand and capital requirements that are often underserved by conventional financing providers.
Selected Firstime portfolio companies include:

Endurance combines Firstime’s sector knowledge, technology insight, entrepreneurial perspective and familiarity with founder-led companies with a team of experienced credit and investment professionals. Their backgrounds span institutional investment management, global banking, infrastructure credit, project finance and specialized lending.

This combination enables Endurance to understand both the commercial potential of innovation-led companies and the financing fundamentals required to support their next stage of growth responsibly. Endurance was rebranded from Firstime Credit in 2026 and continues the platform’s work under a dedicated financing strategy that spans credit and structured capital.

We believe the best outcomes come from structuring capital around the realities of a business — its assets, its contracts, its cash flows and its plan — rather than forcing it into a standardized product.

We work across the capital spectrum, from senior debt to mezzanine and junior debt to hybrid debt-and-equity solutions, and we underwrite with discipline and a clear focus on downside protection. Our aim is to finance growth responsibly: supporting commercial expansion while keeping the capital structure aligned with the company’s long-term sources of repayment.

about: Forbion is a leading global venture capital firm with deep expertise in Europe. We invest in innovative biotech companies, managing approximately €7.5 billion across multiple fund strategies that cover all stages of (bio-) pharmaceutical drug development. In addition, we leverage our biotech expertise beyond human health to address planetary health challenges through our BioEconomy fund strategy, which invests in companies developing sustainable solutions in food, agriculture, materials, and environmental technologies.

Our team consists of over 35 investment professionals that have built an impressive performance track record since the late nineties with 140 investments across 13 funds. We select impactful investments that will positively affect the health and well-being of people and the planet, as well as meet its financial return objectives. Forbion operates a joint venture with BGV, the manager of seed and early-stage funds, especially focused on Benelux and Germany.

Forbion originated in the 1990s as ABN AMRO Capital Life Sciences and rebranded to Forbion Capital Partners in 2006. In 2018, we streamlined our name to Forbion. Since then, our investment team has established a strong track record of sourcing, building, and guiding life sciences companies, resulting in numerous breakthrough therapies and successful exits.
Forbion currently manages €7.5 bn across 13 funds. We currently have 60 active portfolio companies bringing our investments to 140 companies to date, and approximately 90 employees.

Our investors include the European Investment Fund (EIF), through its European Recovery Programme (ERP), LfA, the Dutch Venture Initiative (DVI) and AMUF facilities, and the Kreditanstalt für Wiederaufbau (KFW) through the ERP – Venture Capital Fondsfinanzierung facility.

about: Updated January 2026 As we type our letter, we are already on the hunt for the next vertical singularities. For the founders that became enthralled with such a singularity, and the appetite to build a legendary vertical firm. This is our letter to them.

We founded Foundamental in January 2019 with a thesis, a prior track record, and $60 million in commitments. Five years later Foundamental grows to more than $300 million. As of late 2025, and our third fund, we are flush with the available financial air power to back and cover the most ambitious builders, starting at their day zero.
More than ever, our minds are locked on our search for those who build the next 100 legendary technology companies in the project-based world. They build from the ground up, we bring the air power.

Before Foundamental, its founders had collected a spectrum of experiences across technology, venture, and industrial operations. At our day zero, we looked to some like a random mash-up of our prior successes as investors, engineers, executives and business builders across the heavy industries of energy, chemicals, building materials, automotive and elevators. We, however, felt like the obvious team to build the pre-eminent vertical technology investment firm for the project-based sectors that (re) build our world, due to our unique takes and putting in the work.

Today, the Foundamental team is composed of a dozen unique individuals who expanded our spectrum of experiences and perspectives. All of us coming together to form our unique and controversial takes on technology for the project-based world. Which is powered by our past lives.

As a result, Foundamental’s approach is not to invest in common wisdoms and herd heuristics. Herd heuristics are a force of nature that allows mankind to make sense of the world in highly repetitive situations. The issue with applying herd heuristics is that legendary companies do not repeat. Each has its own unique ingredients.

Our starting point, therefore, is to search for vertical singularities in our project-based sectors, almost always invisible or hard to evaluate until they become obvious later for others who, unlike us, are not set up to spend 365 days a year in our markets.

When we find such vertical singularities, we spend the time on details to build a deep-rooted conviction in those opportunities that most overlook initially. Like the founders we back, we believe that building Foundamental into a legendary technology investment firm therefore requires focus and dedication.

about: Frachtis is a pre-seed venture fund investing at the intersection of crypto and AI. We back founders building a world that is more secure, safer and more sovereign: self-sovereign AI, multi-agent networks, frontier security and the crypto rails that finance and incentivize all of it.

We lead early, often as the first institutional check. Frachtis Fund I is a $20M fund announced in June 2025 by Xavier Meegan , former Chief Investment Officer of Chorus One, with a team of operators from Chorus One, a16z crypto, ZK Validator and Anoma.

AI that people own: their model, their data and their agent. In crypto a share of people chose to self-custody their assets and we believe the same market forms for intelligence. We invest in personal AI hardware, local-first stacks and agents that are loyal to the person they work for. By sovereign AI we mean individuals and organizations owning their AI, not national AI programs. Portfolio: Vora .

Agents that do not trust each other need to find each other, agree on work, attribute it and get paid. We invest in the coordination layer for decentralized networks of AI agents: discovery, intent, negotiation, reputation and attribution. We expect network effects in agent networks to be larger than they were in social networks. Portfolio: Index Network .

Computer security was designed for a world before AI. AI will find vulnerabilities faster than humans ever did and quantum computing will break the public-key cryptography the world relies on. We invest in verification for AI-written code, verifiable computation, agent security and post-quantum cryptography. Portfolio: Sequent , Lurk Lab .

The data closest to our thinking is the most sensitive data there is and people will want to own it. We invest in private data infrastructure, confidential computing and products that let people and companies use AI without handing over their data. Portfolio: Hyve , Vora .

AI agents are always on, global and programmable and they need money that works the same way. We invest in the crypto rails that let agents and AI companies pay, settle, borrow and form capital: stablecoin payments, onchain credit and the businesses that price risk and stand behind it with capital at stake. Portfolio: Masterpiece Labs , Naytive , OyaChat , Turtle .

AI capability is compounding and we want human capability to compound next to it. A prompt is an intent and the best place to understand intent is the mind. We invest in consumer neurotech and personal AI that make people more capable while the data stays in their hands.
frachtis.com.desc: The pre-seed fund for founders wiring crypto into the AI economy, from sovereignty to settlement.
home: For ambitious crypto and AI founders building before it’s obvious.
We invest early with belief, clarity and craft.

Frachtis is a pre-seed fund for founders building the trust layer for a world run by AI agents: self-sovereign AI, verifiable computation, private data and the crypto rails that let agents own, prove and pay. We lead early, often as the first institutional check and we back technical founders before the market has a name for what they are building.

We are operators first. We have run, operated and invested out of Chorus One, one of the world’s largest staking companies, with institutional operating experience at a16z and go-to-market experience at ZKV and Anoma. We put all of it to work for founders at the earliest, hardest stage.

We started Frachtis at the intersection of crypto and AI. What crypto stands for will be applied to AI: decentralized networks, agents that coordinate with each other and sovereign stacks that let people own their own AI.

The risk grows every year that the most capable technology ever built ends up in the hands of too few centralized powers, governments and frontier labs alike. Bitcoin solved this for money by making it ownable and verifiable by anyone. We believe AI gets solved with the same mechanisms.

AI already does things we cannot explain and soon agents will be everywhere, cheap to copy, holding our data and acting on our behalf. Trust has to be built into systems growing this fast in capability and reach, so we can hand them more and know they are secure.

Ownership is how that trust gets built. In crypto, a share of people chose to self-custody their assets and the same will happen in AI: a self-custody market for intelligence, where people own their model, their data and their agent. That market is barely formed. Billions use AI today, mostly as a chatbot and around 2% pay for it, so we look for the new use cases people will pay for, in markets others underestimate.

None of it holds without security, so that is where we go deepest. AI will find vulnerabilities faster than humans ever did and quantum will break the public-key cryptography the world relies on, crypto included. We need battle-hardened cryptography that survives both and systems that upgrade fast.

Leveraging blockchain to outcompete incumbents is no longer an edge. Anyone can use and build with the technology now. Code-only solutions, code execution and permissions all commoditize. So does anything built from public data, anything an incumbent can ship as a feature in a quarter and anything objective, because AI learns it. Value accrues to the application that owns the user, to networks with real network effects and to businesses that underwrite the risk with capital at stake.

about: Deep tech, science-driven founders and the increasing power of computer science are the ingredients we believe will continue to produce great companies. Learn more about our team below.

David leads Freeflow with a focus on investing in and supporting the leading science-based companies that fuel our strategy. Combining his background in finance, deal-making, business development and fundraising, he brings a unique perspective and skill set that drive the growth of Freeflow. With a particular expertise in fundraising, David is a sought after guide for the often uncharted territory of fundraising, especially for early stage deep tech companies.

David began his career as a CPA at PwC and a Consultant at Bain & Company, working on both the buy and sell side advising companies and private equity firms on investments in venture capital and leveraged buyouts, mergers, and acquisitions. During this time he learned the best practices of deal-making, including sourcing, diligence, negotiation, and execution. He then was an early product manager at Google and a senior executive at several startups, including his last, Disqus, which had a successful exit.

It was during this time that he experienced firsthand the disruptive force of computer science, particularly machine learning and artificial intelligence, and saw how it could be utilized to solve challenging technical and business problems.

David is also a member of the Information Science & Technology (IST) Council at Caltech. The Information Science and Technology (IST) initiative is an institute-wide effort that seeks to provide a new intellectual framework enabling ideas from computation to integrate into and transform disciplines across Caltech, e.g. physics, chemistry, biology and planetary sciences.

Steve Roy combines his previous experience as co-founder, start-up marketing leader and brand consultant to collaborate closely with portfolio companies to craft and amplify their stories. Prior to Freeflow, he held lead roles in strategy, marketing and communications at organizations focused on innovation, science and technology. These include start-ups A123 Systems (energy storage), Disqus (online communities), VendOp (supply chain) and Aloft AI (drone software) as well as large entities Philips, Johnson & Johnson, The National Cancer Institute and GE among others.

We’ve dedicated thousands of hours getting to know the brilliant communities of Caltech, JPL and Berkeley. Over more than thirty investments to date, we’ve built a reputation for being good strategic partners that go the extra mile for founders.

Our startup and company-building experience in healthcare, life sciences, software, big data and machine learning enable us to identify high growth opportunities of deep technology breakthroughs and meaningfully assist founders on their translational paths to commercial success.

home: 안전한 바카라사이트를 구별하는 절대적인 기준은 공신력 있는 규제 기관의 라이선스 번호를 클릭해 현재 유효(Active) 상태인지 직접 확인하는 것입니다 . 단순히 웹사이트 하단에 붙어 있는 로고 이미지나 화려한 배당 요율만 믿고 가입했다가는 부당한 출금 거부나 계정 동결 같은 치명적인 재정적 리스크에 직면하기 십상이죠 . 실시간 스트리밍 기술이 고도화된 현재, 영리한 플레이어들은 저마다 최고라 주장하는 광고 문구 대신 내 자산과 금융 데이터를 보호해 줄 기술적 보안 표준을 최우선 지표로 삼고 있습니다 . 왜 아직도 많은 유저들이 이런 최소한의 기술적 검증이나 플랫폼별 규격을 대조해보지 않은 채 섣부른 가입을 반복할까요? 정보 불균형을 깨지 않으면 소중한 시드는 늘 위험에 노출될 수밖에 없습니다. 순식간입니다 .

사실 플랫폼별 이용 약관과 보안 수준을 뜯어보면 자본력의 한계와 제약 사항이 완전히 다릅니다 . 일반적인 이용자라면 최대 배팅 한도가 적절히 설정된 안전한 플랫폼을 찾는 것이 좋고, 대형 베터라면 하루 인출 한도가 넓게 열려 있거나 텔레그램 연동을 통해 완전 익명성을 보장하는 웹3 기반 플랫폼을 선별하는 지혜가 필요한데요 . 주소창의 HTTPS 보안 인증(SSL) 적용 여부와 함께 라이선스 진위까지 교차 검증하는 습관이 필요한 배경입니다 .
본 가이드에서는 푼토 방코의 수학적 우위는 물론, 보너스 받기 전 테이블 게임 특유의 낮은 롤링 기여도 족쇄를 피해 원금을 안전하게 환전하는 필승 전략까지 실무적으로 총망라했습니다 . 불필요한 스캠 리스크를 스마트하게 차단하고 게임 본연의 짜릿한 카드 드로우 액션에만 몰입할 수 있는 가장 확실한 이정표를 바로 확인해 보시죠 .

1. 80벳(80bet) – 최대 100% 올 미적중 보너스 지급 대표 바카라 카지노

80벳(80bet) 는 게임사 검색 기능을 통해 선호하는 온라인 카지노 게임을 쉽고 편하게 플레이할 수 있는 최고의 바카라사이트입니다. 이 플랫폼에서는 블랙잭, 라이브 딜러, 포커, 룰렛, 바카라를 포함하여 다양한 종류의 라이브 카지노 게임을 서비스하고 있습니다. 그 중에서 바카라 게임은 총 46가지를 선보이고 있습니다. 더불어 이 플랫폼에서 대표적으로 유명한 카지노 로비 종류로는 이주기 게이밍, 아시아 게이밍, 패션 TV, 라이브 88, SA 게이밍, 라바 게이밍, 크리드 룸즈, 프라그마틱 플레이, 에볼루션 게이밍이 있습니다. 그리고 이 바카라사이트에서는 스피드 바카라 등 다양한 종류의 바카라 게임을 즐길 수 있어 인기가 많습니다.
80벳(80bet) 2. 벳위즈(Betwiz) – 3,500개 이상의 카지노 게임 지원 최고 바카라사이트

벳위즈(Betwiz) 는 국내 대표 온라인 카지노 산업 선두주자로 알려진 대표 바카라사이트 중 하나입니다. 이 플랫폼에서는 총 33개의 바카라 게임을 선보이고 있습니다. 이 때, 게임을 지원하는 업체들은 에볼루션, 프리그마틱 플레이 라이브, 크리드 룸즈, 럭키 스트릭과 같이 업체 최고의 게임사로 고품질 게임 컨디션을 자랑하는 것이 큰 특징입니다. 그리고 홈페이지에서 지원되는 인기 게임으로는 스피드 바카라 라이브, 한국어 지원 스피드 바카라가 대표적으로 유명합니다. 이 외에도 이 바카라사이트에서는 룰렛, 포커, 라이브 딜러, 블랙잭과 같은 다양한 종류의 라이브 카지노를 한자리에서 플레이해 볼 수 있습니다.

home: These are high-risk investments and you are unlikely to be protected if something goes wrong.
Risk summary for non-readily realisable securities which are shares:
Last updated: 15 April 2024 | Estimated reading time: 2 min
1. You could lose all the money you invest
If the business you invest in fails, you are likely to lose 100% of the money you invested. Most start-up businesses fail.
2. You are unlikely to be protected if something goes wrong

The business offering this investment is not regulated by the FCA. Protection from the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) only considers claims against failed regulated firms. Learn more about FSCS protection here .

Protection from the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) does not cover poor investment performance. If you have a complaint against an FCA-regulated firm, FOS may be able to consider it. Learn more about FOS protection here .
3. You won’t get your money back quickly

Even if the business you invest in is successful, it may take several years to get your money back. You are unlikely to be able to sell your investment early. The most likely way to get your money back is if the business is bought by another business or lists its shares on an exchange such as the London Stock Exchange. These events are not common. If you are investing in a start-up business, you should not expect to get your money back through dividends. Start-up businesses rarely pay these.

home: early stage capital for food & agriculture tech companies
from planetary boundaries to sustainable food systems
driving environmental impact through food & agriculture tech investments
We are a specialist food & agriculture impact fund investing in early-stage companies in Western Europe that change the value chain of food & agriculture. Forever.

Food production accounts for nearly 25% of climate- changing greenhouse gas emissions, is the biggest driver of biodiversity loss, the primary cause of land-use change, one of the largest sources of nitrogen and phosphorus pollution and it generates huge freshwater demand. If we want a sustainable future on earth we need to stay within the planetary boundaries which are holding the stability of the earth together.

In 2009 Johan Rockström led a group of 28 internationally renowned scientists to identify the nine processes that regulate the stability and resilience of the Earth System and are essential for human survival; the planetary boundaries.

The scientists proposed quantitative planetary boundaries within which humanity can continue to develop and thrive for generations to come. Crossing these boundaries increases the risk of generating large-scale abrupt or irreversible environmental changes.
“Nothing short of a systemic transformation of food systems is required to feed the world’s current and future population sustainably under climate change”

We believe, driving innovation and change to these food systems, will eventually transform them from being the cause of overstretching the planetary boundaries to becoming the solution. We also believe that the entrepreneurial minds of our time are up for the challenge. So we contribute by adding capital, knowledge and network to help make a positive environmental impact with their food & agriculture ventures.

Taking impact seriously will be the new norm. We developed our own methodology which we will apply through the whole investment process, from screening deals, creating value and portfolio management, straight to our own impact carry. We have an international impact framework in place bringing transformation to the most pressing themes.

Jalak has extensive expertise across the blockchain, investment and development sectors, and is passionate about pioneering diversity in Web3. This passion led her to found the Collective Future in 2018, an organization to foster diversity and inclusion in the nascent blockchain sector.

Prior to starting FPV, Jalak was the Director of Emerging Market Mobile Investments at Omidyar Network, an impact fund started by Pierre Omidyar, co-founder of eBay. Before NYCIF, she was a Principal at New Venture Partners, an early stage venture fund that commercialized technology out of corporate labs. At NVP, she founded and served as interim CEO of Real Time Content, a personalized video ad platform. From 1999-2003, Jobanputra was at Intel Capital in Silicon Valley, where she invested in data center, enterprise software, internet and digital media startups. She began her career in media, telecom and tech investment banking at Lehman Brothers and Broadview in NYC and London.

Jalak is a magna cum laude graduate of the University of Pennsylvania, with a B.S. in Economics (concentration in Finance) from The Wharton School and a B.A. in Communications from the Annenberg School. She received her MBA from Kellogg.

home: Investing In Early-Stage Technology Founders Transforming Our World And Impacting Future Generations

Gen 1 Americans left everything behind to forge a new life with the hope of a better tomorrow. With only the clothes on their backs, pennies in their pockets, possessions in their hands, they used their biggest assets - their minds, resolve, and a hard work ethic to forge their future.

These gritty and scrappy women and men set forth to build their families and future in the land of opportunity, trying, failing, thinking, learning, and doing. Quitting was not an option, there was nothing to go back to. They stretched every dollar as if it were their last. We remember our 1st Generation American ancestors and hope to make them proud.
We invest in early stage innovators, trailblazers, entrepreneurs, and visionaries who possess Gen 1 values.

Gen 1 Products are often back-of-the-napkin innovative ideas turned proof-of-concept. These Gen 1 products are often inelegant, kludgy, and buggy. Yet it is through experimentation, customer discovery, and immense iteration where products are born. It’s how inventors, entrepreneurs, innovators, visionaries transform the world.

As an inventor, Thomas Edison made 1,000 unsuccessful attempts at inventing the light bulb. When asked, "How did it feel to fail 1,000 times?" Edison replied, "I didn't fail 1,000 times. The light bulb was an invention with 1,000 steps."
We invest in original, authentic, transformative, and disruptive Gen 1 Products looking to revolutionize industries and impact the world.
Gen·e·sis /ˈjenəsəs/ noun - the origin or mode of formation of something

creatio ex nihilo. Creating something from nothing. Going from Zero to One. Not copying or imitating but idealizing and willing something into existence. The creation process is breathtaking and earth shattering. There is not a single process for which Gen 1 Founders build their products, it can be an industry expert identifying an opportunity, an epiphany in the middle of the night, a visionary with a blank canvas, or a creator with the desire to propagate goodness. We want to be part of your origin story.
We invest our time, treasure, and talents to support founders in the creation, innovation, and iterative process to create transformational companies.

about: General Atlantic’s founding investor was legendary philanthropist Chuck Feeney, who had an audacious vision to “improve the human condition.”

Chuck Feeney’s tenacity and long-term thinking set the course for the firm long before he established General Atlantic. He was an entrepreneur first, founding the Duty Free Shopper business and growing it into a global phenomenon. As Chuck’s business gained momentum, so did his interest in investing in new ideas, people, and philanthropic endeavors. This was the beginning of what would become one of the world’s most remarkable stories in business and philanthropy.

In the spring of 1980, Chuck established a direct investment entity. The founding team at General Atlantic would help entrepreneurs build great companies as a means of magnifying Chuck’s ability to contribute to the societal causes that propel global progress. The success would fuel the impact of Atlantic Philanthropies, Chuck’s foundation that made “big bets for a better world.”
Chuck was General Atlantic’s sole investor in the firm for more than a decade.

Chuck gave our founding team the latitude to think outside of the box, follow their instincts, and take an untraditional approach to what was an unprecedented investment mandate. This team saw an opportunity to build a new kind of firm, focused on patient capital and partnership with purpose—laying the foundations for our Growth Equity strategy.

“There was a spirit of working together in that building and being part of a team of people that was always going to back you up. It cannot be overstated how important that was to our early success and how much that translated to the entrepreneurs we invested in.”
– Dave Hodgson, General Atlantic Vice Chairman

From our first office, a brownstone in midtown Manhattan, we have grown into one of the world’s leading investors in growth and innovation, with a committed team of over 900 employees across 21 locations. Our culture and founding values fuel our strategy to this day: relentlessly focused on what’s coming next as we build resilient investment portfolios, partner collaboratively alongside some of the world’s most visionary leaders, thoughtfully manage our clients’ legacies, and create value within businesses, sectors and communities.

glasswallsyndicate.org.desc: Thoughtful notes on everyday choices, household materials and product claims from Nathan Bond.
home: A closer look at the food, materials and routines we often take for granted. Questions worth asking, evidence worth reading, and practical details that matter at home.
With Nathan Bond, a curious Australian perspective on everyday life.

Start with a familiar object or routine. What is it made from? What does the claim actually mean? What would a change involve? These articles look at the details without assuming that every question needs a new purchase.
A useful question leaves room for an answer you did not expect.

I am interested in the choices that fill an ordinary day: what goes in the pan, what touches our skin and how we settle down at night. Here I bring researched context to those questions and keep personal observations separate from broader evidence. A useful answer should explain its limits as clearly as its appeal.
Breakfast, cookware, cooking oils and food storage each raise different questions. Start with the job you need something to do, then look at the details.
A material or ingredient name is the start of a question, not the whole answer.
A fibre label, a laundry fragrance or a furniture finish can invite a closer look.
These articles separate practical comfort and care from promises about health. The aim is to understand the particular choice in front of you, including the cost and effort of changing it.

Feeling better after a change is worth noticing. Explaining the cause takes more care. Explore how to read a study, keep useful notes and judge a claim without asking an observation to prove too much.
glasswallsyndicate.org.title: Everyday choices, examined | Glass Wall Syndicate

about: Entrepreneurs helping entrepreneurs build resilient growth and smart exits
Gorilla Capital is a Nordic institutional angel investor — a “superangel” — built on realism, discipline, and respect for founders.
We invest in companies primarily before product–market fit, with capital-efficient, step-by-step growth that keeps optionality open and avoids premature scaling.

We use eight clear criteria to guide our investments, centered on team focus, customer reality, learning speed, capital discipline, and a credible path to a healthy exit. We call these companies camels, a fitting metaphor for how the journey is made. Resilient, efficient with resources, and always optimizing their pace to maximize the chances of survival, long enough to reach the destination: scalable product–market fit.

Our thinking is grounded in realism, not dreams. Bigger isn’t always better. The median tech exit is €15–20M, and over 80% happen without a Series A. That’s not a ceiling; it’s the reality. By staying grounded, founders can take a meaningful exit or go further if the evidence supports it. Premature scaling destroys that option. The Gorilla approach raises the odds of a successful exit by focusing on customer reality and funding only when there’s proof.

Our operating style is no-BS, transparent, and fast. We don’t waste time on inflated valuations or vanity metrics. Terms are clear, decisions are quick, and communication is honest. We are humble but direct, approachable but demanding.

On the investor side, we treat early-stage as an asset class. Each fund invests in around 100 companies, spreading risk and building a high probability of attractive returns at the portfolio level. The goal is straightforward: healthy exits where founders win — and early investors get the returns they came for.
We are pioneers of this model in the Nordics.
gorillacapital.fi.desc: Gorilla Capital helps ambitious startups grow with smart funding and support. Discover how our team invests in early-stage companies.
home: We invest in camels — ambitious, resilient startups using technology to solve real business problems. Guided by data and discipline, we back capital-efficient founders who learn before they scale and build toward profitability. We partner with people who put customers first and combine humility with relentless grit.
Backing camel founders to build resilient growth and smart exits.

In venture capital, attention often gravitates toward a small number of high-risk, high-reward bets — the potential unicorns. Outside that spotlight, many promising founders are left without the capital they need, even though they could build thriving, sustainable businesses with the right support. Gorilla was born to change that.

Our approach is simple, but different: we invest in camels — capital-efficient, tech-enabled startups solving real problems with customer focus and a realistic path to growth. We typically invest before product–market fit, backing founders who are ambitious yet humble and resilient.

We back ambitious yet pragmatic founders who keep their feet on the ground and steer their own ship. Our model is probability-based and disciplined — always built with the realistic positive exit in mind, regardless the size.

It's about progress, not promises. Growth must be step-by-step, funding tied to milestones, and premature scaling avoided at all costs — because adding fuel to a machine that doesn’t yet work only destroys optionality.
The result: more founders realizing their potential, more companies reaching sustainable growth, and reliable returns for investors.

We back founders solving real problems with technology, growing sustainably, and staying laser-focused on customers. We value curiosity, conviction, integrity, and true entrepreneurial spirit. No egos, no shortcuts, just real work.

Historically, ven ture capital succeeded by investing early in companies that later went public to access growth capit al and establish market leadership.
Over the past twenty years, the U.S. IPO market has shifted focus to mega-cap listings. Mid-sized companies now rarely attract growth capital through U.S. public offerings.
Venture capital time horizons have elongated to over ten years and M&A and private equity are often the only strategic outcomes, stunting opportunity for companies to realize their full potential.
Meanwhile, international economies and capital markets are rapidly expanding. There is a significant demand to invest in high-growth U.S. technology companies that can list on a top global exchange.

home: Gravity Ventures is a member managed angel, pre-seed, and seed capital fund based in Indiana and Arkansas. We invest in early stage technology and tech-enabled businesses across a variety of industries.

What began in 2008 with only a handful of investors managing a single seed capital fund in Indiana, has quickly become an accomplished investment group of more than 60 members overseeing a growing portfolio of early stage technology businesses. Today, Gravity Ventures operates six seed capital funds based in Indiana and Arkansas, and remains dedicated to supporting the endeavors of ambitious entrepreneurs.

Step into a meeting with a Gravity Ventures investment team, and you won’t find us donning slick suits or twirling fancy pens between our fingers. You won’t find yourself in a room full of inflated egos, and you certainly won’t notice any one person seated at the head of the table, calling all the shots from a plush executive’s chair. What you will find is a collaborative, personable group of experienced investors and accomplished entrepreneurs devoting a lot of their time—and all of their brainpower—to helping bright entrepreneurs and promising ventures thrive.

We administer our portfolio cooperatively, and make our investment decisions as a group. We’re a collective of bright-minded, motivated individuals, who in addition to supporting tomorrow’s entrepreneurs, are also pursuing full-time careers, raising families, and managing ventures of our own. Which is why at Gravity Ventures, we don’t just invest in ideas; we invest in people. People just like us.

about: As an early stage VC, we support ambitious founders from the beginning in building companies that drive innovation and change. Our first fund started in 2017 and since then has backed 10 startups from various industries. In October 2024, we closed our second fund, Gründerfonds Ruhr II, with an initial fund volume of €31M.
We empower innovative founders with venture capital and entrepreneurial support.

With Gründerfonds Ruhr, we are empowering founders and innovation in the Ruhr region and beyond. We invest in a broad spectrum of forward-looking sectors, thereby strengthening their innovative power. We not only provide financial capital, but also our entrepreneurial expertise and access to the industry through a leading network of international corporations.

As an early stage VC with a B2B-tech focus, we invest in seed stage companies that are able to solve relevant customer problems with their product and have the potential to become market leaders in their market segment. With our second fund generation, Gründerfonds Ruhr II, we invest across Germany with a focus on the Ruhr region. While we are sector-agnostic, we concentrate on industries like Life Science, Cybersecurity, and Industry 4.0.

Gründerfonds Ruhr was founded in 2017 based on an initiative of the Initiativkreis Ruhr and the NRW.BANK. The idea was to establish the first regional early stage VC fund with a focus on the technology hub Ruhr, a region with excellent entrepreneurial and industrial conditions, enormous innovative strength and great startup potential.

Despite the promising conditions, there has been a lack of capital to fund early stage startups and to support the strong startup and growth momentum in the region. To close this gap, Gründerfonds Ruhr I was launched with a fund volume of €34M as the region’s first private early-stage fund. Gründerfonds Ruhr I is successfully managed by Thorsten Reuter and Jan Gräfe with support from NRW.BANK.

After successfully completing the first fund’s investment cycle, we have reorganized ourselves and are now operating as an independent venture capital fund under the lead of the experienced fund managers Jan Gräfe and Ann-Christin Kortenbrede.

We are based in one of the largest technology hubs in Germany, the Ruhr region. The region does not only offer us great access to 22 excellent universities and colleges, world-leading research institutions and renowned international industry and corporations, it is also the home to an inspiring and thriving startup ecosystem.

about: In 2008, Google's founders asked, “What would it look like to create a radically different kind of venture fund?” It would need to have the reliability of a single LP, the autonomy of a traditional VC, and the technical expertise of a founder. It would need access to Google's people, products, global reputation, and the freedom to invest in direct competitors.

Launched as Google Ventures in 2009, GV originated as an independent venture capital firm for innovative founders. With Alphabet as our sole limited partner, we focus all our energy on meeting and supporting founders at every stage of company-building. Our operating partners support founding teams across executive talent, communications, and marketing. We also connect startups with Google and Alphabet companies, providing unique access to the world's best technology and talent.

GV operates on long time horizons, dealing in decades, not rounds. At launch, we had a $60 million capital commitment and a desire to partner with founders to move the world forward. Today, with over $13 billion in assets under management, we invest from seed to growth stages across the technology and life sciences sectors. We support 400 active portfolio companies across North America, Europe, and Israel. Our portfolio includes notable exits such as Uber , Nest , Slack , GitLab , Duo Security , Flatiron Health , Lemonade , Q , Metsera , Modular , Verve Therapeutics, and One Medical .

We got into venture capital for the venture (and the adventure), to help founders take on the world's biggest challenges, knowing that part of their preparation requires capital. But it also requires the right mindset, building the right team, developing the right product, and picking a partner for the journey with the know-how to give support and space to grow and learn.

While capital may be more accessible than ever, the venture part of VC is still hard. Building a company that spans generations and creates far-reaching, lasting change is still insanely hard. We hope the most reliable piece of the whole journey is the relationship with us.

about: Larsen Jensen is the Founder and Managing General Partner of Harpoon Ventures, a $300M AUM venture capital firm specializing in early-stage technology companies. At Harpoon, Larsen has built the firm from the ground up, raising three funds and investing in dozens of high-profile startups in a variety of sectors.

Prior to founding Harpoon, Larsen gained venture experience at Andreessen Horowitz and Lightspeed Venture Partners, where he supported early-stage companies across various sectors. His journey into venture capital was preceded by a role in Goldman Sachs’ Principal Investment Area (PIA) within its Merchant Banking Division, focusing on private equity and growth-stage investing.

Larsen served as a U.S. Navy SEAL for six years, deploying on combat operations in Afghanistan. He is a combat-decorated veteran whose military service reflects a commitment to mission success and leadership under pressure. The skills he honed in the SEAL Teams—teamwork, strategic thinking, and resilience—now inform his work with founders and portfolio companies.

Before his military career, Larsen was one of the most accomplished American distance swimmers in history. A two-time Olympic medalist (2004 Athens, 2008 Beijing), he still holds the American record in the 400m freestyle. At the height of his career, he simultaneously held the American records in the 400m, 800m, and 1500m freestyle events.

Larsen earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Southern California, where he also gained early financial experience working at UBS and Citizens Business Bank. After leaving the Navy, he pursued his MBA at Stanford Graduate School of Business to further refine his skills in leadership and investing.
When not working with founders or portfolio companies, Larsen spends his time with his family and stays connected to his roots by socializing, working out, and training, with former Navy teammates.

In 2015 we started Hardware Club, a community of more than 600 hardware startups. It grew into a fund that invests from inception to Series A.

hinagroup.com.desc: 汉能投资集团是一家专注于互联网经济、科技、消费及医疗领域的领先投资银行和投资机构。
home: 作为中国领先的精品投资银行，汉能为国内外公司提供卓越的顾问及金融服务，覆盖私募融资及兼并收购，见证并深度参与中国经济转型，积累大批业界著名的顶级案源，曾操盘众多里程碑式的大型并购重组交易，助力科技和医疗巨头崛起。
汉能管理人民币及美元双币种基金，涵盖聚焦早期投资的创投基金和关注成长期、中后期投资的新经济基金。坚持研究驱动及价值驱动，为投资组合提供多元增值服务，多重保障成就科技和医疗独角兽。
小度科技是百度旗下智能生活事业群组业务，作为国内市场规模最大的对话式人工智能操作系统和全球智能屏最大的出货厂商，在行业内占据绝对领先地位。汉能作为财务顾问，参与小度科技独立融资，助力小度科技可释放生态合作的开放势能，引入优质合作伙伴。在“破圈战略”下，为百度在 AI 2 C 领域中取得更大的发展成绩。

Evernote2012年进入中国，是最早为中国用户提供独立中文版软件服务的硅谷公司之一。汉能为Evernote 提供了完整的中国区域业务分拆融资方案，在后续谈判中为多方提供咨询服务，并在极短时间内协调各方资源完成了估值、拆分、牌照申请等一系列分拆运作安排，最大化多方利益，最终促成交易达成。在后续融资中，汉能对接超过60家境内知名基金，组织安排美国管理团队与境内基金多次接触，帮助印象笔记完成分拆独立后的首轮融资，为印象笔记独立发展提供了坚实基础。
去哪儿是国内领先的旅游搜索引擎，其比价搜索服务为网站带来了巨大流量，抢占高市场份额，与中国领先的综合性旅行服务公司携程（NASDAQ：CTRIP）形成激烈的市场竞争。汉能充分分析O2O及OTA行业格局、百度、携程战略布局后，作为百度的财务顾问，汉能建议百度以股权置换的方式向携程出售去哪儿以获取可观回报，同时换取了携程的股东席位，帮助百度深耕在线旅游行业，夯实O2O整体战略布局​。
饿了么是中国最成功的本地生活服务领域企业之一，新零售是目前阿里巴巴重要的集团战略，阿里在产业上下游进行了密集且系统的布局，力求建立以阿里为中心的零售商业帝国。汉能在消费零售行业积累了大量行业经验与资源，作为饿了么财务顾问最终为其选择阿里作为收购方，饿了么之后保持独立品牌、独立运营，并能与阿里的口碑、盒马等打通更多不同品类的商户。
58同城与赶集网分别是中国第一和第二大互联网分类信息网站。在激烈的市场竞争环境下，现金消耗极大，进行行业整合能够明显提高市场效率，推动行业健康发展，汉能此次担任赶集网独家财务顾问，帮助客户梳理复杂的股东背景和公司架构，代表股东谈判并争取了最大利益，促使了交易的顺利完成。58赶集合并后成为我国最大的分类信息网站。
全球领先的云安全服务提供商网宿科技及管理层希望聚焦CDN主业，分拆IDC业务公司秦淮数据，并为秦淮数据引入外部资金发展其重资产的IDC业务，受到IDC行业监管影响，交易结构和条款设计有较高难度，并且上市公司对交易完成时间有明确要求，交易时间表受到极大挑战，汉能深耕IDC市场，出任独家财务顾问，为秦淮数据精准对接数家国内外一线PE机构，增大谈判空间，助其获得更优渥的条款，完成最后交易。
金山云是金山集团旗下云计算品牌，是全球领先的云计算服务提供商，中国Top 3的云计算公司。2017年8月金山云的D系列融资，汉能帮助为公司系统化梳理核心亮点并相应准备了各类专业融资材料。汉能以极高的效率，仅耗时3个月余，就在2018年1月完成了光远资本、骊悦资本、顺为基金、中民投等机构对金山云总计7.2亿美金的D系列投资，这也是中国云计算行业迄今为止最大单笔融资。
汉能联合IDG收购框架38%的股权，并将公司股本结构转换为海外控股公司，帮助框架以1,700万元的价格将液晶业务卖给分众传媒后，完成了框架对分众的整体战略出售，交易对价1.83亿美金。收购完成一年内分众传媒股价上涨近2倍，汉能在股价高点退出全部股权，整体投资回报为93倍。框架传媒2007年收入近2亿美元，净利润超1亿美元，至今仍为分众传媒主要收入来源之一。本次交易被选为成为哈佛商学院经典案例。

Our approach seeks to deliver uncorrelated returns from core economic sectors that require deep expertise and an interdisciplinary skillset to access and navigate.

Our team combines decades of experience from leading institutions, including both investment management and industry operators. We understand the regulatory frameworks, risk profiles, and market dynamics that create sustainable competitive advantages.

We provide customized capital solutions across the value chain and throughout the capital stack. Streamlined. Matching Risk with Capital.

We originate investments that can be structured into multiple risk tranches to optimize risk-adjusted returns for different investor profiles. We offer fund strategies across the risk spectrum and provide insurance company partners with differentiated access to investment-grade credit in our target sectors.

Each strategy leverages our sector expertise and direct origination capabilities to access opportunities which may be overlooked by generalist managers.
We acquire equity stakes in life insurance companies focused on retirement products and consolidation.
We provide private debt throughout the insurance ecosystem through both corporate and asset-backed financing solutions.

about: “One of the things I enjoy most about my role is that no two days are the same. I spend a lot of time exploring new technologies, getting to know startups, and understanding where the market is heading. I also have the chance to meet founders and innovators at conferences and events across Europe, which makes the job incredibly dynamic. It’s rewarding to connect great startup ideas with the right opportunities inside Deutsche Telekom, while working with colleagues who are always open to sharing knowledge and supporting each other.”

“I joined hubraum back in November 2021. From day one, I’ve felt immensely welcome and at home here. My favorite part of the job? Probably the work itself, which I find engaging and challenging and which has developed me professionally. But a close second is my colleagues. They’re all incredibly lovely, as is the opportunity to work in such an international atmosphere.”

“I like that my work combines engineering with innovation in a very practical way. I help build and maintain the technical environment in our Kraków campus, where startups can test their solutions and see how they perform in real-world scenarios. It’s satisfying to solve technical challenges that make collaboration between startups and a large organization like Deutsche Telekom possible. I also really value the international aspect of the role—working with people from different backgrounds means there’s always something new to learn.”

“hubraum hasn’t just been one of Germany’s key incubators for over 10 years but has also established itself as a truly global player thanks to its locations in Krakow, Berlin and Tel Aviv and as part of Deutsche Telekom’s global Partnering footprint, which is connected to innovation and scouting offices all around the world. People who work at hubraum act as innovation drivers, technology evangelists, engineers, creators, project leads, researchers, communicators. Generally, we always have something of interest in the pipeline, so stay tuned and visit hubraum.com frequently!”

Here at hubraum, we’re all about collaboration. We think working together is a lot more fun than working alone — and that it can lead to innovation. It could also be an exciting next step for your career — see below for just some of the benefits a role at hubraum entails.
home: hubraum is Deutsche Telekom’s tech incubator.

Tangible Tomorrow is a program focused on accelerating innovation by bringing together universities, startups, and spin-off companies working in telecommunications and human–machine interaction. The initiative supports projects at different stages of development — from early concepts and research to prototypes and pilot implementations. Its goal is to help promising ideas move beyond the lab and into practical use, delivering value both to industry and to society more broadly.

Welcome to our Security Co-Creation Program — an initiative designed to empower startups at the forefront of (AI-driven) security solutions. Our program seeks visionary technologies to strengthen cybersecurity & network security defenses through advanced solutions in prevention, detection, and response.
If you’re building the future of intelligent cybersecurity & network security, we want to help you bring your innovations to market. Join us to create a safer digital world.
Tangible Tomorrow is an acceleration and research program that unites academia, startups, and spin-offs to shape what’s next in telecommunications and human–machine interaction.
From early-stage ideas to proof-of-concept and pilot deployments, Tangible Tomorrow bridges the gap from research to realization — creating measurable impact for both the industry and society.
Looking for testing or prototyping options?

With a focus on products, services, and enablers strategically connected to Deutsche Telekom’s network and data assets, hubraum has opened up cutting-edge innovation labs in Berlin and Krakow. They welcome innovators from various tech industries, as the labs are equipped with unique telco assets by Telekom, including 5G tech and connectivity APIs, alongside future-proof technologies like Wi-Fi Sensing.

We have two state-of-the-art campuses in Berlin and Krakow. Visitors can access a 5G test bed, a makers’ space and 3D printers at each location. They can also tap into the tech expertise of our engineers, who are based onsite. Also available: office spaces, conference rooms, free coffee and drinks for guests and a buzzy atmosphere.

hubraum isn’t just a startup incubator owned by Deutsche Telekom — we’re a force to be reckoned with. Don’t believe us? Check out our stats so far. We collected these numbers and we couldn’t be prouder of the picture they paint: even after a decade, we’re still growing and striking upon infinite ways to innovate.

Immortal Dragons is a purpose-driven longevity fund headquartered in Singapore. Its investment themes include replacement strategy, 3D bioprinting, gene therapy, artificial womb, longevity special economic zones, and LP positions in other long-bio funds. 不朽真龙基金（Immortal Dragons）是一家总部位于新加坡、投资激进延寿领域、规模4000万美元的使命驱动基金，由朢舶洋（Boyang Wang）创立。基金致力于支持经济回报尚不明确，被主流资本所忽视，但具备长期价值的突破性项目，主要投资方向包括器官替换策略，3D生物打印，人造子宫等。
基金已完成15余项投资，投资阶段覆盖前种子轮至A轮，不限地域。投资之外，不朽真龙出版翻译书籍，资助行业会议和学术机构，制作播客和媒体内容，从而支持抗衰科学研究，布道长寿理念信仰。
朢舶洋（Boyang Wang）是不朽真龙（Immortal Dragons）的创始人，一家总部位于新加坡的使命驱动长寿基金。投资主题包括替换策略、神经与脑年轻化、细胞与基因疗法、生殖技术，同时也作为有限合伙人（LP）投资其他长寿生物科技（longbio）基金。朢舶洋（Boyang Wang）曾就读于新加坡国立大学和耶鲁大学。
具体投资方向包括器官替换策略、3D生物打印、基因疗法、人造子宫，并作为有限合伙人投资其他长寿生物科技（longbio）基金。
替换策略的依据是：基金认为衰老是身体"硬件"的系统性磨损，损伤仍可逆时适合修复，不可逆时只能替换为新的组织或器官。这一方向涵盖异种移植、3D生物打印、组织工程和冷冻保存。
基金认为科学有效性是第一门槛，要求可重复的动物数据和设计良好的早期人体研究。基金优先选择监管路径清晰、技术验证充分、临床需求不可替代的方向，不追逐热点。由于基金把衰老视为多通路、多器官、多层级的同时失衡，倾向安全的多靶点联合干预。

Immortal Dragons (不朽真龙) is a US$40 million purpose-driven longevity and radical life extension fund headquartered in Singapore, founded by Boyang Wang (朢舶洋). The fund backs underfunded moonshot projects: breakthroughs whose economic returns are not yet clear and that are overlooked by mainstream capital, but that hold long-term value. Its main investment themes include organ replacement strategy, 3D bioprinting and artificial womb, among others.

about: Being a venture capitalist is a privilege. One that we don't take lightly. Our philosophy is to serve - serve our LPs, serve the entrepreneurs we work with, serve the customers who support our founders, and serve our communities.

We know what it is like to be underestimated. It can be lonely, frustrating and tiresome. But we also believe that it is within the underestimated that greatness can be achieved. We find great pride in being their champion.
IDEA Fund Partners has been making early-stage investments for nearly 2 decades. We are one of the most active and longest tenured early-stage technology investment firms in the Southeast.
Below are some facts about us and about the investments we tend to make. ​

We believe that talent, entrepreneurial spirit and world-changing businesses aren't confined to the historical innovation epicenters. Many cities in North America have all the ingredients to be thriving ecosystems, yet they are often overlooked by traditional venture capital firms. We will invest anywhere in the country, but we believe that the region between Baltimore and Atlanta represent an exceptional opportunity for outperformance over the coming decade. We focus our deal sourcing strategy to this region.
Our team and expanded network of boots on the ground have decades of experience - funding and supporting the best teams in these underserved regions. ​

We invest in anyone with a good idea and the capacity to execute it, but we have a self-imposed target to build a portfolio where 1⁄2 of our companies are started by underrepresented founders (female, black, Latinx). We feel that this is not just the right thing to do, but also a smart business decision. Investments in underrepresented Founders outperform.
Leveraging emerging technology to automate tasks where computers outperform humans.
home: Greatness can come from anywhere or anyone. It just takes a catalyst to discover it, nurture it and enable it to manifest.

Traditionally, VC has overlooked many great companies because of faulty pattern matching (i.e. geography, experience, education bias) The next set of great companies will be increasingly built outside of core venture markets by non-traditional founders.
Diverse teams will continue to outperform other teams until it's no longer a differentiating factor.
Talented, driven and decent people are the foundation for all great success stories. We want to work with exceptionally talented and driven entrepreneurs with impeccable ethics and decency.
Doing unbelievable things means pressing on when all signs point to no. We back founders with the exceptional conviction that their innovations will disrupt markets or create new ones.
Money is a commodity. Our team provides guidance, expertise and connections to greatly enhance the odds of success for impossible missions.
Success doesn't come in one shape, size, color or location. We seek to rewrite the idea of who and where venture returns are possible.
We are always looking for new opportunities. Please get in touch with us to see if working together makes sense.

about: Imec was founded in 1984 and is today the world’s largest independent research and innovation center for nanoelectronics and digital technology .

As the chip lab of the world , imec drives the advancements that power today’s most cutting-edge technology. By making chips smaller, faster, more affordable, and more sustainable, we tackle the most pressing global challenges , such as climate change, pollution, accessible healthcare, and sustainable food provision. From the chips in your smartphone to the innovations transforming health, automotive, agritech, energy and beyond: imec is shaping the future.
A synergy between talent, infrastructure, and collaboration
Our ambition is supported by three valuable assets:

Our worldwide team of 6,500 scientists, engineers, and innovators from over 100 countries , is driven by a shared passion to push boundaries. With expertise across nanoelectronics, AI, and digital technologies, our people are at the heart of every breakthrough.

Imec’s cutting-edge facilities, including a 3.5 billion euro 300mm semiconductor pilot line , state-of-the-art cleanrooms and labs, provide a technological playground for innovation. This world-leading infrastructure enables our researchers and partners to turn ideas into reality.

We innovate together. Imec works side by side with all players of the ecosystem in a neutral and open innovation model . From industrial partners to startups and over 200 universities: our global and local partnerships accelerate progress and bridge the gap between the lab and the market.

Imec is committed to sustainable developments for current and future generations . As the chip lab of the world, we can and want to inspire and involve the entire microchip value chain. Together we aim to develop technologies that contribute to a more sustainable future by focusing on the positive impact of future chip technologies. Our mission is to create disruptive innovations that make a positive and lasting impact on society .

about: What gets built decides the next decade.
Reindustrializing America is one of our primary objectives. This is the argument, and the companies behind it.
For a generation, the efficient answer was to design here and build elsewhere. The cost of that answer now shows up in supply chains, in the power grid and in the defense industrial base.

The new builders are not rebuilding the old factories. They write software first and use it to run the plant, the reactor, the aircraft and the data center. That produces companies with the learning curve of software and the staying power of heavy industry.

We think this is among the most important investment themes of the next decade. We invest in it deliberately: in companies that add real capacity, sell to customers who need it, and are led by people who have shipped hard things before.
Three theses organize everything we do: power, defend, secure.
Intelligence is now an industrial product.
AI needs land, electricity, chips and steel before it needs anything else. We back the companies that supply them, on the ground and in orbit, on the timeline the buildout demands.

home: Companies looking to grow today face rising complexity and constant disruption. As organizations scale, decision-making slows and clarity fades. Innosight helps leaders cut through complexity, strengthen core performance, and build new sources of growth—so they can move faster and stay resilient.
Managing complexity to accelerate growth

As disruption accelerates, complexity in your organization can make it harder to respond and erode profitability. Explore how managing complexity can improve performance and create capacity for future growth.

Our expertise is rooted in our cofounder Clay Christensen’s pioneering work on disruptive innovation. Our capabilities span strategy through execution, enabling organizations to drive transformation and sustained performance.

In times of change and uncertainty, even successful companies face obstacles to growth. We work with leaders to build resilience into their business models while identifying new opportunities shaped by trends, technology, and evolving customer needs. Our future-back approach embeds strategy into day-to-day decisions and operations, turning ambition into sustained performance.

Innovation is perennially at the top of leadership agendas, yet many organizations struggle with inconsistent results. We turn innovation into a competitive advantage by building repeatable systems that connect customer needs to new products and services. This includes creating a portfolio of initiatives and business model innovations that can be prioritized for investment and scaled to drive growth.

Managing complexity in your business can improve performance today while creating more room to invest in what’s next. We help leaders understand where complexity is driving unnecessary cost or consuming resources, then target changes across portfolios, operating models, and ways of working. By simplifying where it matters, companies can focus resources and management attention on innovation and future growth.

Over time, companies lose visibility into which products and customers are truly profitable as complexity increases and profits concentrate in the portfolio. This effect is even more pronounced when factoring in capital. We help leaders assess portfolios across strategic, financial, and operational dimensions, then take action to restore profitable growth, focusing resources where they create the most value.

When strategy shifts, many operating models struggle to keep pace with new priorities. We work with leaders to redesign how work gets done, integrating AI and digital capabilities so strategy translates into execution and measurable results. With the right governance and performance mechanisms in place, companies can sustain impact over time.

To support growth at scale, corporate functions must connect strategy to execution. We work with leaders to design digitally enabled, AI-powered functions that operate with greater speed and effectiveness, linking decision-making to strategic goals. This enables functions to operate with greater productivity and generate faster, more reliable insights for the organization.

about: We empower foreign-born entrepreneurs to establish their startup in America.

Based in Austin, Texas, we are dedicated to helping foreign-born entrepreneurs achieve success in the United States. Our comprehensive 6-month program offers an immersive experience, providing free housing, office space, and comprehensive relocation assistance. Understanding the unique challenges of launching a company in a new country, we offer personalized mentorship to guide entrepreneurs through every step of the process. Our goal is to equip our startup founders with the right tools and knowledge necessary to thrive in the U.S. business landscape.
We know what it takes for foreign-born founders to succeed.

International Accelerator's journey began with Angelos Angelou , an immigrant from Greece who arrived in the United States with a dream and a determination to succeed. His journey led him to become a pivotal economic development leader at the City of Austin's Chamber of Commerce in the early 1980s, where he is often credited as the “chief architect” behind Austin's evolution into a global technology hub. His contributions have earned him a reputation as one of the power players in Austin.

Driven by a desire to give back and help others achieve their dreams, Angelos established International Accelerator . With a vision to support and empower foreign-born entrepreneurs our program was designed to provide the essential resources, guidance, and community that he wished for during his own journey.

Our program reflects this mission, offering comprehensive support that includes free housing, office space, relocation assistance, and introductions to key industry players. We surround our participants with experienced mentors, an extensive network of corporate partners, investors, and alumni, along with funding opportunities, workshops, and curated resources. By fostering a supportive and nurturing environment, we aim to set up startup founders from around the world for success in the dynamic U.S. ecosystem.

Angelos Angelou's story is a testament to the power of perseverance and community, and it is this spirit that drives our accelerator. We are committed to helping the next generation of global entrepreneurs thrive in the United States, just as Angelos did.
We combine industry expertise and personal experience to support you.

about: Intersouth Partners invested in more than 100 private companies. Founded in 1985, Intersouth managed $780 million in seven venture capital limited partnerships, making it the largest venture capital fund in North Carolina and one of the largest in the Southeast.
